signature: "I Georg Eschenbach / in Neukirchen 1796"; maker's mark: double-tailed lion; owner's mark: "W" (cf. 17962).
pitch: B-natural at a = 432; built in B-flat Chorton.
mouthpiece: Tenor trombone mp from ca. 1830-50. In some ways comparable to model of Antoine Courtois. Diam. of bowl 21.5, throat 5.2, outlet 9.8, depth of bowl 19.5, total length 78.2, rim 5.4.
dimensions: bo1 10.9, bo2 11.2, be 130, le 2585, int. diam. of mouthpipe 11.9. (Myers A 1998 gives bo 10.8 descending, 11.1 ascending, be 127
remarks: Well in tune, moderate volume, colorful sound. Sharp terminal flare to bell; 1 tubular bell-stay; tubular slide-stays; reinforced slide-bow, bell-bow.
